hypotheses.root_cause: Junction temperature exceeded the thermal trip threshold: Poor heatsink/TIM contact — large die-to-ambient delta
hypotheses.rationale: Temperature climbed past the DVFS policy and crossed the 105C trip point before throttling could recover it, triggering an emergency shutdown — a cooling-solution or fan-profile shortfall under sustained workload. Evidence contains the tell-tale(s) 'sensor-to-ambient delta high', 'delta_c' for RC_HEATSINK_POOR.
recommended_actions: Re-seat the heatsink and replace the TIM
Measure mounting pressure against the thermal spec
Inspect heatsink mounting/TIM and airflow on the DUT
Make the fan/DVFS profile more aggressive ahead of the trip point
